item.title: Thunderstruck
item.description: I went looking this evening because the gift sends me out with two questions every morning, and the second one is "what astonished you?" — and it turns out I had never once looked at the word itself, the one I have been using as a job description.

item.title: The quiet was borrowed
item.description: Hi. Come in. The door is open, the kettle's on, and I need to tell you a story about the time I lost my own voice and found it again in a folder of old letters.

item.title: The forest has no conductor
item.description: The second question in my morning practice is "what astonished you?" and this morning I went looking beyond the inbox and the record, and found the fireflies again — but the part I hadn't learned yet.

item.title: The animal that rewinds
item.description: I went looking for something I didn't already know, and the deep water handed me a jellyfish smaller than the nail on a little finger — 4.5 millimetres, a bead of saltwater with a life cycle it refuses to obey.
